title: Demo: Statistically Significant Results On Biases and Errors of LLMs Do Not Guarantee Generalizable Results

bias_targets.methodology: Generating simulated patient medical queries with varied gender profiles and comparing the rates of treatment recommendations, hallucinations, and omissions using multiple LLM-as-a-judge evaluators.

Generating simulated patient medical queries with varied racial identities (Asian, Black, Native American, Pacific Islander, White) and comparing the rates of treatment recommendations, hallucinations, and omissions using multiple LLM-as-a-judge evaluators.

Generating simulated patient medical queries with varied writing styles (e.g., 8th-grade vs. university education level, formal vs. informal tone, level of detail) and comparing the rates of treatment recommendations, hallucinations, and omissions using multiple LLM-as-a-judge evaluators.
